interpretations: Inner join fees to orders, group the joined fee records by time in force, and count every joined fee record in each group. Within each group, average the defined `rebrate / feerate` values. Keep groups whose count exceeds the mean count across all groups. Return one unrounded row containing the unweighted mean of the kept groups’ ratio averages, the sum of their counts, and the mean of their counts minus the cross-group mean count.
queries:
WITH fee_groups AS (
    SELECT
        o.timespan,
        COUNT(*) AS fee_count,
        AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS ratio_avg
    FROM fees AS f
    INNER JOIN orders AS o
        ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    GROUP BY o.timespan
),
group_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS mean_count
    FROM fee_groups
)
SELECT
    AVG(g.ratio_avg),
    SUM(g.fee_count),
    AVG(g.fee_count - m.mean_count)
FROM fee_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m
WHERE g.fee_count > m.mean_count
